integrity: Analytical proof given with explicit radius/angle support and dominated convergence; numerical experiments are diagnostics only. No independent scientific validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite n>=3, spherical dimension two, axially symmetric iid azimuths, arbitrary positive-integrable radial density with finite cotangent moment. The original random-sample containment formula is credited to Wendel. Marked total variation concerns local rescaled coordinates. Historical-priority review is incomplete for some older radial random hull literature.
title: A cotangent-moment law and marked near-pole facets of random hemispherical polygons
